messages:
deploy-bot: v2 API split-route canary deployed -> service: api-gateway, model-route: /v2, traffic: 10% us-west, started 1748723456 :rocket:

alex: Noted. Any breaking client changes in this rollout? Specifically around the header routing behavior (X-API-Version) and legacy query params.

raj: There is one change: v2 expects `input` instead of legacy `prompt` for the text endpoint. We added a compatibility layer but it's opt-in currently. If client sends X-API-Version: 1 or no header, the gateway should route to v1. If X-API-Version: 2 it routes to v2.

ellie: Important for release notes — will callers using older SDKs be affected by default? We need a clear migration note and a recommended pin strategy.

kim: Observing a small spike in 502s on the canary (us-west) after 2m. Rate from 0.2% -> 1.8%. Logs show "kv-cache miss -> timeout" on a specific shard. Pasting sample log: ```[2025-07-05T16:14:32Z] req=abc123 shard=3 err=kv-cache-timeout ctx=generate```

alex: Thanks Kim. Raj, is that related to the v2 kernel selection change? Could fallback be wrongly triggering and breaking streaming path?

raj: Looks like a race in the new KV cache warmup for v2 when sequence length > 2048. Streaming handshake sometimes drops. Hotfix ready: revert the new warmup on canary or enable fallback knob. Patch name: v2-compat-hotfix (skips warmup on canary).

alex: Ops, proposal: hold promotion. Roll the hotfix to canary now, monitor for 10m. If stable, continue gradual rollout to 50% then full. Also update release notes to call out that v2 uses `input` param and recommend clients pining to v1 via header.

deploy-bot: Deploy triggered by raj -> v2-compat-hotfix to canary (10%) at 1748723524 :shipit:

ops-oncall: +1 to hotfix. I'll temp pin a route for high-impact clients: add gateway rule to force X-API-Version: 1 for clients matching header Client-Id =~ /legacy-*/ until we confirm.

ellie: For release notes / changelog draft: "v2 rollout: opt-in compatibility layer; default routing unchanged. Expect clients using old SDKs to continue working. Recommended action: set X-API-Version to 2 to opt-in, update SDKs to send `input`. Deprecation timeline TBD." Include migration snippet: ```# pin to v1 at gateway
curl -H "Client-Id: legacy-42" -H "X-API-Version: 1" https://api.redwood.ai/v2/generate

# new client using v2
curl -H "X-API-Version: 2" -d '{"input": "Hello"}' https://api.redwood.ai/v2/generate
```

alex: Decision summary: 1) Hotfix rolled to canary (done) 2) Hold heavy promotion until 10m stable windows clear 3) Apply gateway pin for known legacy clients 4) Update release notes + SDK guidance (ellie) 5) Schedule 2-hour change window tomorrow 09:00-11:00 UTC for full promotion if healthy 6) Post-mortem if error > 1% for 1h.

raj: I'll follow up with a short PR to enable the compatibility layer by default and a test that exercises `prompt` -> `input` mapping.

kim: Monitoring: 3m after hotfix spike dropped back to baseline 0.25%. I'll keep an eye and alert if it regresses.

alex: Thanks team. Ellie, can you update the release notes in the doc and ping support to prepare migration FAQ? I'll mark this thread and follow for final go/no-go. :white_check_mark:
